title: "Break the Silence" Campaign to Encourage Intervention in Family Violence Situations
what_it_is: "Break the Silence" Campaign to Encourage Intervention in Family Violence Situations

sections.label: Family violence not private matter
sections.summary: Family violence is not a private matter, and the community including neighbours, family, friends and strangers can help tackle it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The key message is that family violence is not a private matter.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The community, including neighbours, family members, friends and even strangers, can play a very important part to tackle family violence.

sections.label: Awareness efforts and help channels
sections.summary: Over three years the Ministry will work with community and corporate partners to raise family violence awareness and equip bystanders, and victims can approach Family Service, Family Violence Specialist or Child Protection Specialist Centres.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Over the next three years, my Ministry will work with our community and corporate partners, including through ground-up efforts relating to music, through the sports community and the arts community, to further raise awareness of family violence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We also have roving community roadshows, training sessions and collaterals being produced to help raise awareness and to equip bystanders with resources and also to update them on skills that are required to safely step in to help victims.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Anyone who encounters family violence can call or approach the nearest Family Service Centre, Family Violence Specialist Centre or community-based Child Protection Specialist Centre.

sections.label: National Family Violence Networking System
sections.summary: Agencies are connected through the National Family Violence Networking System and respond regardless of where the first report is made, with the Ministry, Specialist Centres and Police addressing victim safety in serious cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Agencies are connected through the National Family Violence Networking System and will respond to cases regardless of where the first incident report is made.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Where there are serious concerns, my Ministry will work closely with the Family Violence Specialist Centres and the Police to address the safety of the victim and any other vulnerable members in the family.

sections.label: Calling hotline or Police
sections.summary: One can raise concerns, call the hotline or call the Police if necessary when worried about those affected by excessive violence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: If at all, perhaps, it is just to raise concerns, call the hotline or call the Police, if necessary, if you think it is excessively violent and you are concerned about the well-being of those who are affected.
